classification_decisions.note: Original issuer company material and an October 2024 post identify Generative Rights Management: authorization of AI use, provenance/audit trails, licensing permissions and royalty enforcement. Assign AI security and governance because the product governs AI-specific rights and use. The assignment is a business-scope judgment, not validation of advertised model-blocking effectiveness. Preserve the source-verified $100,000 financing.

Source-supported identity-continuity inference: Kevin William David identifies himself with ListenOwl and later names The Audio Company in his own hiring post; the original seed investor Saka now links its personalized-audio portfolio entry to Lissin, operated by The Audio Company Inc. Original Lissin product material describes researching, scripting and voicing personalized podcasts/stories/songs. Assign creative AI applications, not proprietary audio/speech models. Keep the historical ListenOwl name and February financing; current product evidence does not certify a historical rebrand or pivot date. The placeholder .ai site is not used as product evidence.

source_policy: Original issuer/investor/regulatory sources, original journalism, and credible public professional funding records. Approximate amounts are acceptable; unresolved additional rounds and date boundaries remain explicit.
financial_limits: The 21 remaining discovery claims lack a verified additional financing, calendar year or private-close date. They are not a count of proven missing deals.
